text: 机构研究主管凯瑟琳·布鲁克斯周三表示，最新CPI数据支持英国央行采取“鹰派式暂停”。但是真正的通胀冲击可能出现在9月。布鲁克斯表示，目前尚无迹象表明通胀正在向更广泛的经济领域传导。不过，通胀报告中原材料成本同比上涨6.1%，出厂价格上涨3.7%，这些成本要么最终转嫁给本已承压的消费者，要么挤压企业利润率，两种情况都不利于英国经济。布鲁克斯指出，核心通胀保持稳定是积极信号，但英国央行已经表示，能源价格如今比核心通胀更能影响通胀预期。此外，能源价格上限持续高企也令未来通胀面临上行风险。布鲁克斯认为，尽管市场已下调英国央行近期加息预期，但未来加息仍不能排除，目
text_en: Kathleen Brooks, head of research at an institution, said on Wednesday that the latest CPI data supports the Bank of England taking a "hawkish pause." But the real inflation shock may come in September. Brooks said there are currently no signs that inflation is spreading into the broader economy. However, in the inflation report, raw material costs rose 6.1% year-on-year, and factory gate prices rose 3.7%. These costs will either ultimately be passed on to already-strained consumers or squeeze corporate profit margins, and neither scenario is good for the UK economy. Brooks pointed out that stable core inflation is a positive signal, but the Bank of England has already said that energy prices now influence inflation expectations more than core inflation. In addition, the persistently high energy price cap also poses upside risks to future inflation.
